notes.title: New Patch Release
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We have released a new patch today with the following features:

- Razer Chroma support added.
- New music added for the opening animation.
- Some minor improvements to the gameplay have been made.

Thanks for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy the latest changes!

Pewter Games & Curve Digital
